APPOINTMENT AND DEDUCTION TERMS
Original delivery appointment: August 12, 2026 at 10:00 AM Eastern, AP-BSC-771 revision 1.
A $600.00 flat late-arrival fee applies only if carrier check-in is more than 30 minutes after
the effective confirmed appointment, and the delay is carrier-caused.
Written appointment changes approved by the customer transportation team replace earlier
appointments. A customer-requested reschedule is not a carrier-caused delay.
Timeliness is determined by receiving gate check-in, not unloading completion.
